playbook.name: Arkansas Relational Organizing Playbook
principles: Neighbor-to-neighbor trust carries more weight than generic persuasion scripts.
Local messengers should lead outreach in their own networks.
Phone trees should map to county captain and precinct captain ladders.

operationalPatterns.pattern: County captain -> city/precinct captains -> volunteer cells.
Build phone-tree branches anchored in trusted community ties.
Use fairs/festivals/civic events to refresh volunteer momentum and recruit trusted messengers.

guardrails: No contact list generation from this layer.
